name: Mozambican Piri Piri Chicken

steps_detailed: Blend the jalapeño, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, and paprika into a smooth sauce.

name: Mozambican Matapa
description: Matapa, cassava leaves simmered in ground peanuts and coconut milk, is widely considered Mozambique's national dish - real cassava leaves aren't a distinct item here, so spinach stands in for a milder, less fibrous approximation, real technique building the sauce slowly so it doesn't separate.
steps_detailed: Cook the garlic in a little oil 30 seconds.
Whisk in the peanut butter gradually, then the coconut milk, keeping the sauce smooth.
Add the spinach and simmer 15-18 minutes until well combined and thickened.
